data.name: Rayhaan
data.gender_notes: Rayhaan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rayhaan is an Arabic name that refers to a fragrant flower or a sweet scent. It symbolizes the beauty and elegance of a person's character. The name Rayhaan carries the meaning “Fragrant, Sweet Scent” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Rayhaan usually hope their child will grow to embody fragrant, sweet scent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Rayhaan is considered one of the gates of Paradise, where the sweet scent of flowers welcomes the righteous.
data.etymology: Rayhaan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Fragrant, Sweet Scent.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rayhaan total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: ريحان
in_arabic.meaning: ريحان يعني النبت الطيب الرائحة في الجنة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم ريحان مشتق من الفعل راح و يعني النبت الطيب الرائحة ، و في القرآن الكريم ذكر اسم ريحان في سورة يس آية ١٢ و قال تعالى : و ريحان من الجنة ، و يعتبر اسم ريحان من الأسماء المحببة عند المسلمين لما له من معنى جميل و طيب

in_urdu.name: ریحان
in_urdu.meaning: ریحان کا مطلب ہے جنت کا خوشبو دار پودا
in_urdu.long_meaning: ریحان ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے جنت کا خوشبو دار پودا ، یہ نام قرآن مجید میں سورة يس آية ١٢ میں ذکر کیا گیا ہے ، جہاں اللہ تعالیٰ نے فرمایا ہے : و ريحان من الجنة ، یہ نام مسلموں کے درمیان مقبول ہے کیونکہ اس کا معنی خوبصورت اور خوشگوار ہے

in_hindi.name: ریحان
in_hindi.meaning: ريحان का अर्थ है स्वर्ग का सुगंधित पौधा
in_hindi.long_meaning: ريحان एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है स्वर्ग का सुगंधित पौधा , यह नाम कुरआन में सूरत यासीन आयत १२ में उल्लेखित है , जहां अल्लाह तआला ने फरमाया है : व रिहान मिन अलजन्नाह , यह नाम मुसलमानों के बीच लोकप्रिय है क्योंकि इसका अर्थ सुंदर और सुगंधित है

in_pashto.name: ریحان
in_pashto.meaning: ریحان د جنت خوشبو لرونکی ګل معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: ریحان د عربي نوم دی چی د جنت خوشبو لرونکی ګل معنی یی دی ، دا نوم د قران کریم د سورت یس ایت ١٢ کی مینځ کی ، چیرته الله تعالی فرمایی : وریحان من الجنة ، دا نوم د مسلمانانو تر منځ مشهور دی ځکه چی د معنی یی ښکلی او خوشبو لرونکی دی

in_english.name: Rayhaan
in_english.long_meaning: The name Rayhaan originates from the Arabic root 'r-ḥ-n' which conveys the sense of fragrance and sweetness. It is mentioned in the Quran, Surah Yasin (36:12), where Allah says, 'And a fragrance from Paradise'. The name symbolizes spiritual fragrance and blessings. Historically, it has been cherished in Islamic tradition for its beautiful connotations and is often associated with pleasant scents and paradise.

In Arabic culture, flowers and their scents are often used as metaphors for beauty, grace, and elegance. Rayhaan, as a name, embodies these cultural ideals and is often given to babies as a reminder of the importance of cultivating admirable traits and characteristics.

The name also reinforces the Islamic belief in the importance of cultivating good deeds, as a fragrant flower not only beautifies the environment but also inspires admiration and joy in those around it.
